tertile_fit.threshold_rule: Upper edge of bin containing nearest-rank 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles; ties may yield unequal or empty groups
tertile_fit.real_group_count_rule: Exact histogram-bin sums at frozen bin-edge thresholds with exact Y=1 endpoint correction; identical to direct pixel membership

pair_brightness_difference.definition: abs(Y(center)-Y(neighbor)); both GT labels 0..3; same/different semantic class, not instances
pair_brightness_difference.sampling: Native grid starts at (64,64), stride128; tiny images use their center; for each 4 distances x8 directions choose <=32 valid centers without replacement using per-record NumPy RNG from SHA256 of seed42/scene/sample_id/source_id/group; original dataset order retained
pair_brightness_difference.unordered_pair_duplicates: Grid stride128 exceeds all offsets, so reverse-pair centers cannot occur; each direction samples without replacement
pair_brightness_difference.median_rule: Average upper-bin edges of the two central nearest-rank order statistics

image_tagging_rules.large_crater: Largest 8-connected GT crater component has >=5% of all image pixels
image_tagging_rules.border_crater: At least one 8-connected GT crater component touches any image edge and has >=0.1% of all image pixels
image_tagging_rules.mountain_rock_mixed: GT mountain and GT rock each occupy >=0.5% of all image pixels, and a rock pixel is within Chebyshev distance <=8 pixels of a mountain pixel
image_tagging_rules.denominator: All native image pixels, including sky and ignored pixels

thresholds.file_provenance_note: All image/mask native paths, sizes, mtimes, inode/device and shape recorded; file stats checked before/after each read; authoritative manifests and record ordering content-hashed

domain_definition: All conditions intersect fixed GT terrain IDs0..3; GT sky4 and ignore255 excluded, predicted IDs0..4 retained
conditioned_iou_definition: For each fixed brightness/texture set, accumulate its complete 5x5 CM across all GT terrain classes; TP/(GT+pred-TP), GT-absent class null; average present terrain classes only
recall_and_destination_definition: Each true-class row divided by its GT count in the same condition, including predicted sky; zero denominator null
brightness_definition: RGB numerical luminance proxy, not physical irradiance and not a shadow label

special_conditions.local_std: 31x31 reflect padding, float32 luminance, float64 moments, clipped nonnegative variance, float32 standard deviation
special_conditions.local_std_domain: All raw RGB neighbors enter the window; GT terrain mask applies to scored center pixels

gt_image_tag_rules.large_crater: Largest 8-connected GT crater component has >=5% of all image pixels
gt_image_tag_rules.border_crater: At least one 8-connected GT crater component touches any image edge and has >=0.1% of all image pixels
gt_image_tag_rules.mountain_rock_mixed: GT mountain and GT rock each occupy >=0.5% of all image pixels, and a rock pixel is within Chebyshev distance <=8 pixels of a mountain pixel
gt_image_tag_rules.denominator: All native image pixels, including sky and ignored pixels

tag_grid: Native original GT before any evaluation resize; tags may overlap and are not disjoint totals
rgb_alignment: Reread raw RGB; if sizes differ use dataset-matching PIL bilinear RGB and nearest GT; require exact scored GT equality

paired_within_image_recall.definition: Same image and true class with dark and bright GT counts each>=64; image-weighted dark-minus-bright recall, descriptive association rather than causal effect

prediction_encoding: L-mode uint8 class-ID PNG, 0..4, evaluated image coordinates
